eyebrow: The magic commands worth knowing now
code:
%python   # run this cell as Python, regardless of default
%sql      # run this cell as SQL
%md       # render as formatted Markdown, not code
%fs       # a DBFS filesystem command (Lesson 8)
caption: %md cells are how a real notebook stays readable, not just code with no narration.
